messages:
ana: Quick UX thread: prototype for compact run badges + small preview action menu. Trying to surface ID/status/summary without expanding full JSON.
sam: Love this. Question: are badges computed from the declared schema or heuristics?
ana: Plan is schema-first with a heuristics fallback for older models.
matt: UX nit: badges should be keyboard-focusable and announce full text on hover/focus (aria-describedby).
julie: Perf note: for responses >25KB, show a single "Large response" badge and require explicit inspect to avoid parsing on list load.
ridhi: a11y: ensure color isn't the only signal (add icons + visually hidden text). Also use aria-live when preview content updates.
diego: Copy options request: "Copy JSON", "Copy as TS type", and "Copy as Python dataclass". Put the last two in the kebab menu.
sam: Label tweak: use "Open in function editor (jump to response)" so the action stays clear.
matt: Acceptance criteria: lazy-load previews, keyboard flows documented, contrast AA for badge text, perf fallback for big payloads.
ana: I'll upload mock screens + keyboard-only walkthrough later today.
